jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About IntouchCX
  
  
IntouchCX is a global leader in digital customer experience management, back office processing, trust & safety solutions, and AI services. For over 25 years, we’ve scaled with soul, building trusted long-term partnerships and empowering our people to drive positive change.
  
  
About the Job
  
We seek a dynamic and detail-oriented Partner Operations Analyst to enhance our operations. This role is vital for ensuring the highest performance standards across our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) agents by gathering and analyzing key metrics, monitoring trends, and effectively communicating findings to enhance our operations and customer service. This role supports regional locations including the Philippines, India, and Latin America.
  
  
As Operations Analyst, You Will…
  

* Regularly collect and analyze daily performance metrics from BPO agents
* Identify trends and conduct comparative breakdowns of longitudinal data to provide actionable insights
* Monitor daily and weekly contractor staffing levels and provide forecast adjustments
* Prepare clear and persuasive presentations for internal and external stakeholders
* Share insights and overviews effectively, ensuring data is understandable and actionable.
* Provide prompt ad hoc communication with leadership when identifying trends or to push along coaching agendas
* Work closely with Partner Operations Managers to implement data-driven strategies and improvements
* Provide support and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment
* Understand and comply with company standards and policies
* Continuously monitor and evaluate agent performance against company standards and objectives, suggesting and implementing improvements when necessary
* Support new product and technology launches including UAT testing and communication release planning
* Be responsible for extracting production data from CRM, Dialer, and reporting platforms to formulate BPO production reports

As Operations Analyst, You Have…
  

* High school diploma or equivalent (required)
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in the contact center industry
* Preferably 2 years of experience in a Product/Operations environment
* Proven managerial experience with a strong focus on data analytics and operations
* Strong knowledge in Google Workspace (Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Slides)
* Excellent presentation skills with the ability to convey complex data to diverse audiences, including internal and external contacts
* Strong time management, organizational skills, and integrity
* A passionate commitment to quality and excellence in service delivery
* Strong focus on enhancing customer experience
* High resilience and ability to work under pressure with quick turnaround times
* Expertise in time management, capable of multitasking effectively in a detailed and organized manner

IntouchCX will never ask for payment, money, financial or banking information during the recruitment process. We only communicate through official channels.
  
  
Should you receive a suspicious job offer, or posting, from anyone claiming to be an IntouchCX employee, please report it immediately to hr@intouchcx.com for review and validation.

jobs.description:
**Why Work Here**

* Headquarters is in Charlotte, NC
* Recently expanded to nearshore,Hyderabad
* isolved ranked for SMB Payroll in 2023 Sapient Report
* Voted top places to work in USA 2023

**Job Description**

Associate Product Manager, Suite Experience

**Summary/objective**

isolved is modernizing the user experience across its HCM platform, built on a shared design system. In this role you will work from our Hyderabad office as the day-to-day product owner for three development teams, each building new pages and experiences for a different product area at the same time.

The design system is already in place, so the job is less about designing from scratch and more about building the right thing correctly. You will make sure each new page does everything the current one does, works for every user role, and handles real-world edge cases. You will also answer the many small product and UX questions that come up during development. You will work closely with US-based product leadership, and the role requires regular overlap with US business hours for handoffs, planning, and decisions.

**Core Job Duties**

* Document how current pages work, including fields, actions, user permissions, and edge cases, so nothing is lost when they are rebuilt
* Own backlog refinement and sprint readiness for three development teams working in parallel
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that cover page behavior, validation, error and empty states, role-based access, and accessibility
* Answer day-to-day product and UX questions from developers, using the existing design system and escalating only where a new pattern is needed
* Review completed work against acceptance criteria and sign off before release
* Manage feature flags for your teams' work, within the release plan set by the Group Product Manager
* Take special care with compliance-sensitive workflows, where a missing date, notice, or record creates legal risk
* Keep roadmap items current in our planning tools (Airfocus, Azure DevOps)
* Work with US-based product leadership, support, and QA across time zones, through overlapping meetings and a daily written handoff

A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Emerging understanding of broader organizational context and goals. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented, journey-level position.

* Attention to detail. You notice the missing field, the unhandled error, or the wrong permission.
* Comfort working from a design system and making sensible UX calls within it
* The ability to keep three teams moving at once and to prioritize under pressure

* Clear written English. Much of the collaboration with US teams happens in writing.
* Availability for regular overlap with US business hours

**Preferred Qualfication**

* HCM domain knowledge, especially in one or more of: COBRA or benefits administration, applicant tracking (ATS), or learning management (LMS)

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager I
jobs.description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are::

* **5+ years of product management experience** building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
* **An AI-forward way of working**. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
* **A business owner's mindset**. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
* **Technical fluency**. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
* **A strong point of view**, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus points**

* You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
* You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
* You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
* A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
* Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
* Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
* A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing::

* Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
* Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
* Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
* Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
* Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
* Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
* Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

jobs.title: Staff Inbound Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**The role**

ServiceNow is looking for an Inbound Product Manager to make Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) easy to start and easy to expand across the enterprise. You’ll own two product areas that drive adoption of the SPM suite.

**Time to Value** helps new customers complete setup faster with less hands-on help. It also gives executives a view of where SPM is delivering value over time and where to focus next.

**Enterprise-Wide Deployment** lets established customers scale one SPM instance across multiple business units while keeping common governance and allowing controlled differences in data access, user experience, and process.

As an inbound product manager, you’ll own what gets built in these areas from problem definition through release. You’ll work directly with engineering, customers, and partner product teams to decide what to build and in what order. Adoption and expansion are how SPM grows within our customer base, so this role has significant visibility and direct impact on that growth.

**What you’ll do**

* Own Time to Value. Define the vision and roadmap for capabilities that get new customers through setup faster with less hands-on help, and that show executives where SPM is delivering value and where to focus next.
* Own Enterprise-Wide Deployment. Define the vision and roadmap for capabilities that make it simple for customers to extend SPM to new business units while keeping governance consistent.
* Rethink adoption with AI. Find new ways for AI to help customers plan, implement, and adopt SPM, including implementation agents that take on setup work customers and partners do by hand today.
* Coordinate across the portfolio. Partner with adjacent product teams on how they adopt these capabilities, so changes land cleanly across products.
* Build with customers. Run discovery with customers, partners, and field teams to find and prioritize the problems worth solving, and turn what you learn into clear requirements engineering can build against.
* Measure what matters. Define success metrics for setup speed, value realized, adoption, and expansion, track them after release, and use the results to shape what comes next.
* Make the case. Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, and roadmap priorities to executive, technical, and customer audiences.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8+ years of software product management experience shipping enterprise products
* Experience writing requirements, building roadmaps, and partnering with engineering on feasibility
* Executive presence: experience presenting plans and positions to senior leaders, and earning alignment even when you’re pushing back
* Execution excellence: a record of delivering high-quality, scalable capabilities quickly
* Customer obsession: the ability to turn complex customer needs into simple solutions
* Data-driven mindset: using qualitative and quantitative insights to guide decisions and measure success
* Strategic problem-solving: comfort with ambiguity and a habit of finding the root problem

jobs.title: Product Analytics Lead
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
About Technology@Lilly
  
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
About the Business Function
  
The Software Product Engineering (SPE) team is a specialized engineering group that delivers strategic solutions and differentiated capabilities. We take a forward-thinking approach, focusing on an enterprise platform and product mindset, ensuring that the solutions we build can be leveraged across Technology teams for broader impact and efficiency.
  
  
About the Role
  
Our team builds digital and AI-powered products that improve how employees work and interact with technology at Lilly. We are looking for a Product Analytics Lead to establish how we measure product success, understand user behaviour, and monitor the health and performance of the technology we build.
  
  
The initial focus of this role will be ChatNow, Lilly’s conversational AI experience, with the opportunity to support and shape analytics across additional products as our portfolio grows.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, AI and Data. The Product Analytics Lead will bring together product behaviour, engineering telemetry and business context to generate insights that help teams understand what is working, where problems exist and where to focus next.
  
  
Responsibilities and Key Objectives
  
  

* Own product measurement strategy across the portfolio, defining the metrics and frameworks needed to measure product adoption, performance and outcomes.
* Lead analytics for ChatNow as the initial priority, analysing adoption, engagement, user journeys, quality and product effectiveness.
* Establish product and engineering metrics across reliability, performance, latency, errors, cost and other key indicators of product health.
* Build dashboards, monitoring and alerting using tools such as Grafana, Splunk and Power BI to make performance visible and surface meaningful changes.
* Turn data into actionable insights, identifying trends, anomalies and opportunities and translating them into clear narratives and recommendations.
* Partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Data and business teams to establish instrumentation, measure outcomes and inform product decisions.
* Apply AI to analytics, using GenAI and agentic AI to accelerate analysis, identify patterns and investigate anomalies while appropriately validating results.

Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Business Analytics or a related field.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, engineering analytics, business intelligence or a related analytical function.
* Demonstrated experience using SQL and at least one analytical programming language such as Python or R.
* Demonstrated experience developing dashboards and data visualisations using Grafana, Splunk, Power BI, Tableau or similar platforms.
* Experience working directly with product managers, software engineers and business stakeholders to define metrics, analyse performance and translate data into decisions.

Additional Skills / Preferences
  
  

* Experience with Generative AI, agentic AI or LLM-powered products, including using AI to accelerate data exploration and analysis.
* Experience with experimentation, hypothesis testing, A/B testing or other structured approaches for measuring the impact of product changes.
* Experience defining and analysing product and engineering health metrics, including user journeys, reliability, performance and operational telemetry.
* Experience designing monitoring, anomaly detection and actionable alerting using observability platforms such as Grafana, Splunk or similar technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to turn complex analysis into clear narratives, insights and recommendations for technical, business and leadership audiences.

Additional Information
  
  

* Travel may be required depending on business need.
* This role may support teams and stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Business Onsite Buying Experience team owns the end-to-end Amazon Business website and mobile experience, enabling customers to (1) discover products and features via the business homepage, navigation, and search, (2) purchase through search, detail page, cart, and checkout, (3) track, manage, and reconcile purchases post-purchase, and (4) get help through conversational AI via Alexa for Shopping and Amazon Business Assistant.  
  
We are looking for a senior product leader to own the innovation and growth in one or more feature areas within the charter with innovative, relevant and personalized solutions tailored to business user personas. This product leader sets a long-term vision for the assigned area, ensures alignment with overall Amazon Business vision and creates and executes the roadmap to improve customer experience with new features and experiments.  
  
The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels in dealing with significant ambiguity and has keen interest in business procurement experience that is vastly complex with multiple user roles, groups, entities, and thousands of users for each customer. He/she will possess strong analytical capabilities, stellar verbal and written communication skills, thorough understanding of e-commerce consumer behavior and purchase funnels, and drive to rapidly test/learn/iterate mentality. The product leader also brings strong collaborative skills and ability to engage leaders from technical teams, go-to-market teams (sales, customer support, and professional services), and UX/customer research teams to communicate and/or draw insights on customer needs/pain points and drive consensus on investments.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Execute on the current roadmap and constantly evaluate the prioritization to make maximum impact of available bandwidth.  
2. Define three year product vision for the assigned areas that is a complement to the overall AB vision to serve different customer segments - from SMBs to Enterprises - on both desktop and mobile.  
3. Create a roadmap that meets current and future requirements for Amazon Business customer segments, such as enterprise, SMB and Micro segments.  
4. Work with other product managers in Amazon Business to ensure their roadmap and vision are aligned with a focus on cohesive experiences and reusable UX components/patterns. Own Northstar metrics for assigned feature area(s).  
5. Work with engineering teams to build scalable solutions that enable rapid experimentation and incremental optimization on a continuous basis once the initial solutions are delivered.  
6. Partner closely with other AB feature teams, go-to-market teams, UX/customer research teams, and Retail teams to deliver features in the assigned feature areas within the buying journey.  
7. Be the interface and subject matter expert for your assigned feature areas, create and nurture relationships with other AB feature teams and retail teams.  
8. Contribute to tech strategy of your features and provide guidance to tech teams to come up with future-proof designs.  
9. Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

* Problem Solving: Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to isolate infrastructure, pipeline, or code configuration failures under tight release deadlines. Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working within cloud data warehouse environments or data engineering release tracks.

* Certification in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or relevant cloud/DevOps practices.

* Experience managing releases in multi-tenant or complex enterprise client ecosystems.

GitLab, GitHub, CI/CD

**Good-to-have skills**

Cloud data warehouse, Data engineering, Git Lab certification

jobs.description:
**Senior Product Manager, New Games**

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**About Liquidnitro Games**

Liquidnitro Games is a game development company built to create, launch, and scale ambitious games for a global audience.

Founded by industry veterans with deep experience across free-to-play, live services, and large-scale game production agnostic of platforms, we bring together product thinking, design craft, engineering depth, art execution, data, and live operations under one roof.

We build games from the ground up, take new ideas from 0 to 1, and work with select partners to strengthen, scale, and operate high-quality game experiences.

Our teams combine creative ownership with production discipline, helping projects move from early prototypes to validated products, and from launch to long-term growth.

At Liquidnitro, we are building the next generation of game teams, products, and tools from India for the global games industry.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Manager**
to help build, launch and scale an ambitious new free-to-play mobile game.

This is a hands-on product leadership role for someone who understands what makes games fun, how players engage with systems over time and how to translate great gameplay into a sustainable product.

You will work closely with game designers, engineers, artists, producers, analysts and leadership to shape the product from development through launch and live operations.

We are looking for someone who can move comfortably between creative discussions and product analytics, challenge assumptions, make thoughtful trade-offs and take ownership of measurable player and business outcomes.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Own Product Strategy and Player Experience**

* Define and drive the product vision, goals, roadmap and success metrics in collaboration with game leadership.
* Translate the creative direction into a compelling player experience with strong core gameplay, progression, engagement and retention systems.
* Understand player motivations, behaviors and friction points across the entire player journey.
* Establish product priorities and make decisions that balance player experience, development constraints and commercial opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate the game within the competitive F2P mobile market.

**2. Drive Development From 0 to 1**

* Partner with design, engineering, art and production to take the game through development, testing, launch and iteration.
* Define and prioritize features based on player impact, product goals and development feasibility.
* Establish clear acceptance criteria and measurable success outcomes for major features and systems.
* Drive playtesting, qualitative feedback and data-informed iteration to validate product hypotheses.
* Make pragmatic scope and prioritization decisions to deliver a focused, high-quality game.
* Work with cross-functional teams to resolve product ambiguities and ensure alignment around priorities.

**3. Build Retention, Progression and Monetization Systems**

* Partner with game design to shape progression, rewards, economies, content systems and long-term engagement loops.
* Understand how gameplay, difficulty, pacing and rewards influence player motivation and retention.
* Develop thoughtful F2P monetization strategies that complement the core player experience.
* Evaluate virtual economies, IAP systems and engagement mechanics to establish sustainable long-term product health.
* Identify and address issues such as progression friction, economy imbalance and retention drop-offs.

**4. Establish Product Analytics and Experimentation**

* Define and track KPIs across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, conversion and monetization.
* Partner with analytics and engineering to ensure appropriate telemetry, dashboards and reporting are in place.
* Build hypotheses, interpret quantitative and qualitative insights and translate findings into actionable product decisions.
* Design and evaluate experiments to improve player experience and business performance.
* Analyze player cohorts, funnels, progression, content consumption and feature performance.
* Build a strong understanding of the relationship between game systems and product metrics.

**5. Lead Launch Readiness and Product Growth**

* Define product readiness criteria and success metrics for internal testing, soft launch and global launch.
* Partner with publishing, marketing, user acquisition and live operations teams on launch strategy.
* Identify product risks and performance gaps early, and drive corrective action.
* Support the transition from development into ongoing live operations.
* Develop post-launch priorities around player engagement, content, feature improvements and sustainable growth.

**6. Drive Cross-Functional Product Leadership**

* Be an accountable product decision-maker who brings clarity to complex and ambiguous situations.
* Communicate product strategy, priorities, risks and performance to leadership and stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with producers while retaining ownership of product outcomes, player experience and feature priorities.
* Balance creative ambition, player needs, technical feasibility and business performance.
* Foster a culture of player empathy, experimentation, accountability and continuous improvement.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Demonstrated experience working on free-to-play mobile games, ideally across development, launch and live operations.
* Experience shipping at least one game or owning substantial product features and systems through launch.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Quantitative Analytics
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
We are looking for a driven, curious individual contributor to join a cross-functional product team responsible for building quantitative analytics and financial modeling capabilities for buy-side firms, with a focus on instrument pricing, portfolio analytics, and data-driven reporting within a SaaS platform serving hedge funds and asset managers. You will partner closely with a global team of domain experts who will provide mentorship as you grow your domain depth.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own features from concept to delivery across quantitative analytics workflows, producing roadmaps and feature specifications through domain deep-dives into instrument pricing, portfolio analytics, and financial modeling.
* Articulate product value propositions drawing on knowledge of capital markets, multi-asset class coverage, portfolio analytics, and how buy-side firms use quantitative data to inform trading and portfolio decisions.
* Partner with engineers, quantitative analysts, and platform architects to translate domain requirements into product, bridging quantitative methodologies, trading desk workflows, and data pipelines while coordinating timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across workstreams.
* Build comprehensive test cases covering calculation accuracy, scenario outputs, data mapping, exception handling, and end-to-end integration with upstream and downstream systems.
* Grow domain depth over time through mentoring from the global quantitative and product team, self-study, and hands-on collaboration with domain experts.

**What You'll Need**

* 8+ years in front, middle, and/or back-office roles; 4+ years in product management or a similar role on a SaaS product or module, ideally B2B.
* Graduate degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, or a related quantitative field; CFA, FRM, or equivalent professional certification, preferred.
* Interest in capital markets and the products traded by buy-side firms such as hedge funds and asset managers.
* Basic understanding of financial instruments (bonds, equities, FX, derivatives) and how they are priced, or a strong willingness to learn; familiarity with quantitative finance concepts such as sensitivities, scenario analysis, or portfolio-level analytics is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with agile delivery: writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria and keeping a prioritized backlog.
* Able to work closely with engineers, understand technical trade-offs, and discuss APIs, data, and system design at a high level; working knowledge of SQL or Python for data exploration and analysis is an advantage.

As an Associate Product Manager at Alacriti, you will drive the vision, roadmap, and development of our cloud-native money movement and payments platform. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, performant, and developer-friendly payment solutions that delight users and accelerate digital transformation for our financial clients. We are seeking candidates with 3+ years of product management experience, specifically with a track record of owning platform, API, or developer-facing products end-to-end.

* Develop the long-term vision and strategy for the product and create and execute on a compelling roadmap
* Build deep user empathy with Alacriti’s clients and partners, understanding global payment industry trends and competitors' offerings to influence the roadmap effectively
* Collaborate with engineering, design and other teams to jointly shape product experiences that delight end-users
* Ensure we are building a reliable, performant platform, including system reliability, API extensibility, and latency
* Use metrics to inform point of view and leverage analytics to measure success

* Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility

**Who you are**

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

You see strong platform design as a way to help users move faster, create better products, and unlock new business models.

jobs.title: Product Manager, GenAI Products (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
Who We Are
  
  
Techdome is a product engineering company that helps enterprises move from “we should use AI” to AI running reliably in production. Our cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, and AI specialists build LLM applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous agents, and workflow automation for clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Everything we ship comes with the security, integrations, and compliance that enterprise buyers require.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
A GenAI demo is easy to build. A GenAI product that passes a security audit, stays within budget, keeps cost per query under control, and earns the trust of its users is not.
  
  
We’re hiring a Product Manager who wants to own that second problem. You’ll take products from the first client conversation through launch and growth, and you’ll be the one who catches the fuzzy requirement, the dropped handoff, or the hidden risk while it’s still cheap to fix.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**Define the product**

* Turn a client’s raw idea into a clear product definition with realistic scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets.
* Learn each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and translate them into requirements engineers can build from without guessing.

**Get GenAI into production**

* Work with ML engineers to turn LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, and safe systems.
* Set and monitor the production metrics that matter: accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query.
* Ensure every AI feature integrates with client systems through APIs and meets enterprise standards for security, data privacy, and uptime.

**Align the team**

* Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so every handoff is explicit.
* Plan capacity and hold all parties to their commitments.
* Manage relationships with third-party partners, including LLM and cloud providers.

**Manage risk and communication**

* Run formal change control whenever scope, timeline, or budget moves.
* Raise delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early, including hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and cost overruns.
* Track delivery in JIRA or Azure DevOps and keep clients and leadership informed with no surprises.
* Use AI tools to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

What You Bring
  
  
**Required**

* 2+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and within budget.
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having launched an LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a working understanding of the AI lifecycle and its risks.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and of tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Enough technical depth in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
* Good judgment on risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including with senior client executives.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost optimization.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Domain expertise in FinTech or Healthcare.
* Cross-industry experience and the curiosity to learn a new domain quickly.

Your First 90 Days
  
  

* Days 1–30: Learn how Techdome delivers, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects.
* Days 31–60: Independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, risks, and client relationship.
* Days 61–90: Land a key milestone, make a visible improvement to how we run projects, and earn the trust of your team and clients.

Why Join Us
  
  

* Technically demanding GenAI work across several industries.
* Daily collaboration with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.
* A real voice in how projects are planned, run, and delivered.
* The chance to build deep expertise at the frontier of GenAI.

**About Skolasti**

Skolasti is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for running an online academy. Each customer gets their own branded academy, with its own domain, coaches, courses, learners, payments and certificates, all on shared infrastructure that we operate.

The academy is the core unit, and it scales with the customer. A solo coach can launch one in an afternoon. A training business can run it with a team of coaches. An institution can run several programs, cohorts and roles inside it. The product is built for that whole range, and growing customers along it is a big part of this job.

We host live and recorded courses with DRM-protected delivery, assessments, certification, learner engagement, analytics and AI-assisted learning. We have the platform. Now we need someone to turn it into a growing SaaS business.

**The role**

You will own Skolasti as a business, not just its roadmap. You'll be accountable for how many academies sign up, how many become paying, how fast they get value, how long they stay, and how much they grow.

This is a hands-on, senior role. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO and a small engineering team, with no layers of product management in between. You decide what we build and why, and you prove it worked with numbers.

**What success looks like**

**First 90 days**

1. Interview at least 20 academy owners across segments, including some who churned.

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer - ETS
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
At Apple, we rely on our employees diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives to champion innovation through extraordinary ideas to surprise and delight our customers. These ideas can come from anywhere. Will that next phenomenal idea come from you? Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.” Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
  
  
Description
  
  
Build AI-powered internal platforms that ETS runs on, from the database to the UI, and make them observable in production. Forge builds the internal platforms Apple's Enterprise Technology Services uses to plan and operate large-scale infrastructure. These platforms put decisions on shared, current data, integrate with many internal systems, and move teams onto common standards through automation. We are now building the AI-agent layer on top of them: agents that work as operational members alongside engineers, with human judgment always in the loop. WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE EXCITING You will take real ownership early. You'll work with product owners, infrastructure teams, and engineering partners across ETS, learn how their systems fit together, and turn that into features, integrations, and automation that teams use every day. Senior engineers review your designs and help you grow toward leading design for a component. You will also help build the AI-agent layer on our platforms, in the same codebases our engineers ship to daily. You may start closer to product or integration work, and you should be comfortable moving between the two as the work changes. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Full-stack engineers who have shipped features to production, can apply security and scalability basics in a design and explain their choices, and learn new technologies quickly.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* 2+ years of professional software development, including shipping features to production
* Full-stack experience: a backend language such as Java (Spring Boot or similar) and web UIs built with React or Angular
* Working knowledge of security principles (authentication and authorization, least privilege, secure data handling) and scalable patterns (stateless services, caching, asynchronous messaging, retries), and the ability to apply them in a design and explain your choices
* Solid fundamentals in data structures, design patterns, REST API design, and relational databases, with a focus on testable, maintainable code
* A record of learning new technologies quickly, working through ambiguity, and communicating clearly with teammates and stakeholders

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Have built an LLM- or agent-based feature, whether in production, as a prototype, or as a project, and can describe how you designed and tested it
* Observability experience: using metrics, logs, and traces to understand and troubleshoot a running service
* Python, including LLM APIs or agent frameworks
* Daily use of GenAI coding tools (Claude, Copilot, Codex) to speed up development, testing, and debugging
* Secure software practices: security design reviews, dependency and vulnerability management
* CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Schema design and query optimization on PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL
* Web accessibility (WCAG) and building accessible enterprise UIs
* Experience mentoring interns or junior engineers, or contributing to inner-source or open-source projects

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

  

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

**Role Overview:**
  

PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against — keeping delivery moving in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

  

This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort — the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market — with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.

  

As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high-quality, high-value features. You'll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired.

  

This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.

  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
* Stay aligned with and contribute to the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework
  
* Translate roadmap initiatives and solution briefs into detailed, engineering-ready PRDs and user stories
  
* Help define and evolve requirements for MEM's publishing engine — how customers configure, preview, and push changes to their live mobile app
  
* As needed, extend into Mobile Platform-level decisions (what should be configurable, extensible, or standardized across customers) as they intersect with MEM
  
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer-reported issues affecting the mobile app and platform experience
  
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand product needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  
* Use AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  
* Develop documentation for new mobile and MEM features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
  
* Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
  
* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
  
* Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  
* Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
  
* Own release planning for Mobile Platform and MEM initiatives
  
  

  
**Qualifications:**
  

  
* Prior experience with consumer-facing mobile apps (iOS/Android) — writing requirements, PRDs, or user stories for a mobile product strongly preferred
  
* Experience with platform, framework, or configurable/multi-tenant products is a strong plus, given the customizable nature of the Mobile Platform
  
* Comfort defining requirements for a 0-to-1 product (like MEM) with evolving scope, including working with design on portal/UI workflows
  
* Ability to break down ambiguous roadmap items and solution briefs into scoped, sequenced, engineering-ready PRDs
  
* Familiarity with mobile-specific considerations (app store release processes, platform guidelines, mobile UX patterns) is a plus
  
* Fluent with — or genuinely eager to learn — AI-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  
* 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
  
* Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
  
  
The Product Owner partners closely with
**Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams**
to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
**clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact**
in a complex, enterprise data environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership & Accountability**

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Business Alignment**

* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.

**Backlog, Roadmap & Delivery Management**

* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.

**Governance, Quality & Standards**

* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:

+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.

**Adoption, Value & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.

**Leadership Behaviors & Expectations**

* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.

**Why This Role Matters**
The Product Owner is a
**critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model**
, ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

The Data Platform Product Owner is responsible for helping define, prioritize, and drive the evolution of the enterprise data platform as a product. The role will help ensure that the platform is designed to address business needs and is tailored to the organization structure and scale, while simultaneously being an advocate for data-driven decision-making and the enablement of the platform across the organization.

Acting as the bridge between business domains, data platform teams, and engineering, the Product Owner translates business needs into clear platform requirements, defines priorities, and ensures delivery of capabilities that maximize business value. The role is accountable for maintaining a clear product vision, roadmap, and backlog for the platform, balancing strategic initiatives (e.g., data products, governance, marketplace, migration) with operational stability and efficiency.

The Product Owner works closely with platform engineering, data architects, other Product Owners and DevOps teams to ensure that platform capabilities are delivered in a standardized, reusable, and scalable manner. They also collaborate with business stakeholders and product teams to define how the platform is consumed, ensuring clarity in delivery models, ownership, and support structures.

A key responsibility of the role is to establish and enforce ways of working for the platform, including intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and governance standards. This includes ensuring that data product ownership, privacy-by-design, and compliance requirements are consistently embedded across all platform use cases.

As a key figure in a global, organizational-scale software initiative, the Data Platform Product Owner must be a promoter of the Agile mindset and a champion of continuous delivery and feedback, cooperating with the DevOps teams to implement practices that generate incremental and steady feature delivery at scale that adapts quickly to feedback and business changes.

**Preferred Candidate Profile:**

- Proficient in reading drawings (civil and services), MS Office/Excel; exposure to project scheduling tools preferred.

- Strong communication and coordination skills for client, consultant, vendor and team management.

- Willingness to be based full-time at the Aizawl site; prior experience of working in remote or difficult-terrain project locations will be an advantage.

- Accommodation provided by the company.

- Fooding (meals) provided by the company.

- Other benefits as per company policy.

We are looking for a Sr. App Services Functional Consultant to join our Life Sciences Application Services team. In this role, you will own requirements and testing for life sciences application implementations, from business analysis through release readiness. jobs.description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

The Product Analytics team at Seismic turns product and customer data into insights that shape what we build, where we invest, and how our go-to-market teams work. We analyze how customers and internal teams use our platform, measure the impact of product and AI investments, and partner with product, engineering, and GTM leaders to make faster decisions.

Our analysts design experiments, define metrics, build dashboards, and create AI-assisted workflows that make trusted insight available across the company and help customers get more value from the platform.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst in India who pairs strong analytical skills with hands-on AI fluency. You will work across the full analytics maturity curve, from descriptive reporting (trusted metrics, KPIs, and dashboards that show what is happening) through diagnostic analysis of large, complex data sets to predictive models and prescriptive recommendations that drive decisions.

You will lead high-impact projects and work closely with product managers and leaders, software and data engineers, fellow analysts, and GTM partners (sales, marketing, and customer success) across India and North America.

Who you are::

* MS in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics), or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years in analytics or data science, with expert SQL on a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks), expert Python, and applied statistical and machine learning modeling.
* Deep analytical expertise, amplified by AI: uses AI assistants and coding agents to speed up SQL, Python, and analysis, builds reusable, high-quality AI skills that capture how an expert does the work, and validates outputs against human review and protects sensitive data.
* Experience with A/B testing and causal inference to validate business impact, including low-traffic or account-level experiments.
* 3+ years building actionable reports and dashboards that drive stakeholder decisions, using any modern BI tool.
* Experience measuring the adoption and business impact of AI-powered product features, including defining quality signals for non-deterministic outputs.
* Can turn ambiguous problems into decisions and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Naturally curious and passionate about solving problems with data: asks why before building, challenges assumptions (including their own), learns new tools quickly, takes ownership of outcomes, and helps teammates succeed.
* Working knowledge of git and a cloud platform (e.g., AWS)
* Nice to have: dbt, Streamlit, event-based product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Amplitude), building agents with MCP or LLM orchestration frameworks, and B2B SaaS or go-to-market analytics.

What you'll be doing::

* Analyze product and business data (user behavior, feature adoption, customer health, GTM performance) to shape product strategy and platform investment decisions.
* Own top-level business, team, and product metrics, and build automated, actionable reports and dashboards, partnering with Data Engineering on trusted data models and consistent metric definitions across the unified platform.
* Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, causal inference, and quasi-experimental methods) to validate hypotheses and quantify business impact.
* Build reusable AI skills, tools, and agents that encode our analytical expertise and automate recurring analysis, turn unstructured data such as customer feedback and conversations into usable signal, and let product and GTM teams get trusted answers.
* Partner with product and engineering on instrumentation, and measure post-launch adoption and impact, including usage, quality, and cost of AI-powered features.
* Apply statistics and machine learning to build, deploy, and monitor predictive models (e.g., churn, expansion, or feature-adoption propensity) with cross-functional teams.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership, and proactively identify new analytics opportunities that influence company strategy.
* Mentor analysts and raise the team's analytical rigor and AI fluency.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

**Job Description: Technical Product Manager – Enterprise Data Platform**

**Experience:** 5+ years | **Level:** Mid-Level

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Technical Product Manager to help shape and deliver our enterprise data platform, enabling how data is ingested, governed, discovered, accessed, and consumed across the firm. This role will work closely with data engineering, architecture, security, and business stakeholders to build scalable, reusable platform capabilities that simplify data onboarding, strengthen governance, and enable self-service data consumption across users, applications, and AI agents. The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding of modern data platforms with hands-on product management experience, and is comfortable translating complex technical and business requirements into practical solutions. They should be able to operate in a fast-moving environment where platform capabilities are being built iteratively, with a focus on usability, scalability, and adoption.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Partner with product and engineering leadership to define and execute the roadmap for enterprise data platform capabilities, balancing foundational platform investments with business-facing features.
* Translate strategic objectives and stakeholder needs into prioritized product initiatives, MVP scope, user stories, and actionable engineering backlogs.
* Manage dependencies across interconnected platform capabilities, aligning delivery milestones, technical readiness, and adoption.
* Define success metrics covering platform adoption, operational efficiency, governance, and user experience.

**Product Definition & Design**

* Define product requirements for reusable data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks that simplify how engineering teams build and operate data pipelines.
* Design standardized workflows and automation capabilities that improve developer experience and operational efficiency.
* Define requirements for platform observability, data quality, and operational controls to improve reliability and scalability.

* Incorporate metadata, data ownership, classification, lineage, and data quality into platform workflows and user experiences.

**Product Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Work closely with engineering teams throughout design, development, testing, and release to ensure solutions meet business and technical objectives.

About Bazaarvoice

At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.

The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty.

Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.

Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

### **Job Description**

Influenster is the product-passionate member community at the heart of Bazaarvoice’s Consumer Acquisition & Sampling (CAS) business. Members discover products, try samples, and share honest reviews that power brand campaigns. The CAS Fundamentals team owns the core member experience that keeps this community healthy: onboarding, identity, trust, discovery, and the everyday reasons members come back.

As the Senior Product Manager for CAS Fundamentals, you will keep members happy, engaged, and coming back to Influenster. You will own the strategy and roadmap for the foundational member experience across web and app, and you will balance member delight with the legal, compliance, and data-quality foundations that make our campaigns work for brands.

### **How you’ll make an impact**

* Define the strategy and a 1–2 year roadmap for the Influenster member experience, with clear ownership of the CAS Fundamentals KPIs:

  + Monthly Active Members on Influenster
* Own the core member journey end to end, including:

  + Onboarding and activation
  + Member identity
  + Feed and search
  + App integration
  + Localization
  + Legal and compliance requirements
* Drive engagement and organic content growth and run experiments to grow the volume and richness of organic content.
* Discover and validate problems through member research, funnel and cohort analysis, and experimentation. Turn them into prioritized, well-scoped bets.
* Balance competing investments: member growth and engagement, trust and compliance, and the content inventory that supports brand campaigns.
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Legal, Marketing, and other CAS teams to ensure aligned backlogs and that engineering has what it needs to size, build, and ship.
* Own the full product lifecycle from discovery and build through launch, measurement, and iteration. Communicate outcomes with data-driven narratives that connect member engagement to business results.
* Stay close to the market: community, creator, and loyalty-app trends, plus the competitive landscape for consumer review and product-sampling experiences.

### **Essential Criteria**

* Experience building and scaling mobile apps in a D2C setting (helpful)
* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in consumer-facing products where engagement and retention are core metrics (communities, marketplaces, loyalty, social, or content platforms).
* Strong ownership of engagement metrics (MAU, retention, activation) and the ability to design and analyze experiments to move them.
* Experience with foundational consumer product areas such as onboarding, identity and account systems, feed or search, and localization.
* Ability to work through legal, privacy, and compliance requirements (consent, data handling, verification) without losing sight of member experience.
* Comfort with data: you define success metrics, run analyses, and use product analytics tools to make decisions.
* Ability to prioritize across competing goals and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a multi-sided environment serving members, brands, and retailers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of working closely with engineering and design.
