At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
eBay is looking for an experienced, highly driven product leader to own the growth of eBay Balance - our stored-value, wallet product.
  
  
In this role, you will define how eBay Balance serves customers across non-U.S. North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with an initial focus on markets such as Canada, Australia, and selected European countries. You will build experiences that enable customers to receive funds, hold value, reload their balance, and spend that value back on eBay.
  
  
This is not a localization or feature-maintenance role. It is an end-to-end product ownership opportunity: identifying the highest-potential customer use cases, shaping the international strategy, launching new capabilities, and creating the adoption flywheel that makes eBay Balance an everyday part of how customers engage with eBay.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of payments, commerce, and financial services - operating at the scale and complexity of one of the world’s largest global marketplaces.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Own the international product strategy and roadmap for eBay Balance across Canada, Australia, Europe, and additional non-U.S. markets.
* Identify the most valuable regional customer problems and determine where eBay Balance can create differentiated value for buyers and sellers.
* Design and improve the complete stored-value lifecycle, including how customers:

+ Receive or earn funds
+ Add or reload money
+ Hold and manage their balance
+ Spend funds back on the eBay platform

* Develop new product features, incentives, and customer experiences that increase activation, adoption, repeat usage, and spend.
* Build a market expansion framework that balances customer demand, business opportunity, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, and platform scalability.
* Lead products from discovery through launch and optimization, bringing structure and momentum to complex, ambiguous initiatives.
* Use customer research, behavioral data, financial analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, validate opportunities, and make high-quality product decisions.
* Define and own success metrics such as activation, funded accounts, reload behavior, balance retention, repeat usage, spend-through, and incremental business impact.
* Partner closely with the product leader responsible for U.S. eBay Balance to build shared platform capabilities while addressing market-specific customer and regulatory needs.
* Align and influence stakeholders across engineering, design, analytics, business, payments, operations, finance, risk, legal, and compliance.
* Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and business results clearly to senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Establish repeatable capabilities that allow eBay Balance to expand efficiently into additional markets over time.

**What You Will Bring**

* 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful experience in payments, digital wallets, stored-value products, fintech, financial services, or commerce.
* A track record of shipping and scaling complex customer-facing products across multiple teams or markets.
* Solid understanding of payment flows, funding methods, money movement, wallet experiences, or account-based financial products.
* Demonstrated success driving product adoption, engagement, retention, or transaction growth - not simply delivering features.
* Experience translating ambiguous business opportunities into a clear strategy, prioritized roadmap, and executable product plan.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to use customer insights, experimentation, and data to make decisions.
* Experience influencing engineering, design, analytics, business, risk, compliance, and operational partners without relying on direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex topics and make clear recommendations to senior executives.
* High ownership, urgency, and resilience. You are energized by difficult problems, move decisively, and stay accountable from strategy through measurable results.
* A global approach and an appreciation for how customer behavior, regulation, payment infrastructure, and business models differ across markets.

**Description**
Amazon Compliance Safety Services is looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Tech to own the compliance intelligence platform that powers how Amazon understands, structures, and applies regulatory requirements across global marketplaces. You will define how compliance requirements are modeled, stored, and made available to downstream systems that protect sellers and customers. This role sits at the intersection of regulatory knowledge, data architecture, and seller experience, working with engineering, science, legal, and program teams across multiple countries. You will own the product roadmap for structuring compliance data at scale and making it machine-readable, reusable, and accurate across product safety, trade, and labeling domains.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own the product roadmap for the compliance intelligence platform, including how regulatory requirements are ingested, structured, and distributed to enforcement, seller experience, and automation systems
  
  
Define the data model for compliance requirements at specification grain, enabling cross-policy and cross-marketplace deduplication
  
  
Partner with engineering to build scalable infrastructure for storing and serving compliance data across global marketplaces
  
  
Work with regulatory and program teams to translate evolving regulations into structured, machine-readable requirements
  
  
Define success metrics and drive adoption of compliance data across consuming teams and surfaces
  
  
Represent the compliance intelligence charter in planning cycles, leadership reviews, and cross-org alignment forums
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You will spend your time translating regulatory complexity into structured product decisions. In a given week, you might define how a new regulation maps to existing product categories, review a data model proposal with engineering, align with a program team on requirement coverage gaps, and present the roadmap to leadership. Your customers are the internal teams that depend on accurate, structured compliance data to enforce the right requirements, surface the right guidance to sellers, and automate decisions at scale. You will own the "what does Amazon require" question end to end.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon Compliance Safety Services ensures products sold on Amazon meet safety and compliance requirements worldwide. The Compliance Intelligence team within CoSS is responsible for building the source of structured compliance requirements, covering product safety, trade regulations, and labeling across all global marketplaces. The team works closely with engineering in India and Romania, regulatory program teams, and seller-facing product teams to ensure compliance data is accurate, complete, and usable at scale.

Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

jobs.description:
Closing date for applications: 20/11/2026

Location Bangalore, India

Job typePermanent | Contract typeFull Time

#R-00287946

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as an Infrastructure Engineer

* You’ll engineer infrastructure technology for public and private cloud environments, complying with security, resilience, sustainability, and operational requirements with observability and guardrails built in
* You’ll also use automation to provide testing and a route to live for the product, working with customers to help them use our products appropriately through a users’ CI or CD pipeline
* This is a chance to work with colleagues across the bank to share engineering best practices, allowing you to expand your network and gain exposure for you and your work
* We're offering this role at associate level

**What you'll do**
------------------

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll contribute to and manage the selection, creation and maintenance of technologies required to meet the needs of our customers, strategic targets and architecture outcomes, along with developing products using modern engineering practices and tools.

We’ll look to you to collaborate with stakeholders to inform product roadmaps, detailing lifecycles of the technology from new products through to end of support and retirement. You’ll also support engineered products and respond to user feedback, new feature requests and resolve production issues wanted by the Product Owner.

Additionally, you’ll:

* Develop technical skills through continuous learning and development
* Work within a team to design intuitive, self-service infrastructure products
* Contribute to the delivery of infrastructure as code solutions
* Work with users to help use our products and gain feedback
* Provide operational support for pattern or product related issues
* Generate innovative ideas and drive the delivery of those through product features

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

To thrive in this role, you’ll have experience in software development or automation scripting such as Python or Shell, with an understanding of the software development lifecycle. You’ll also have experience in utilizing modern infrastructure as code via tooling.

We’ll expect you to bring a good understanding of Agile working practices and toolsets with the ability to relate everyday work to the vision of the feature team, platform and domain.

Furthermore, you’ll need:

* Minimum four years of experience in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related cloud platform roles
* Minimum three years of strong experience in AWS products & services, with strong focus on security, and controls
* Extensive automation experience with demonstrable skills in IaC using Terraform, and Python
* Practical experience of designing, and using CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, automated testing and deployments
* Software development or scripting skills, with experience of the SDLC along with good understanding of Agile methodologies and toolsets such as Jira
* Drive to make sure that solutions have security considered from the outset
* excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills
* Capacity to focus on the customer, empathise with them

**Welcome to our Bangalore hub**
--------------------------------

Located at Taurus 4, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, our new office stands as a state-of-the-art hub for innovation and collaboration.

### **Key facts:**

* A 30 acre campus
* Space for 6,000 colleagues
* Opened in 2025

### **Our tech stack**

Here’s just some of the technologies we use.

### **Front end**

* JavaScript
* ReactJS
* AngularJS

### **Back end**

* Python
* Java
* Microsoft Dynamics

### **DevOps**

* AWS
* GitLab
* Google Cloud Platform

### **Data**

* Kafka
* Hadoop
* PostgreSQL
* Snowflake

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Over 2 million Sellers in 10 countries ship billions of products for sale on the Amazon Marketplace. To meet our sellers’ needs, we are constantly innovating and building on new ideas. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) Inbound analytics and data science team partners with product team to optimize inbound supply chain by influencing right tradeoffs among cost, speed and network capacity utilization.
  
  
FBA Product Analytics team is looking for an individual with excellent analysis and statistical skills, deep knowledge of business intelligence solutions, and the ability to work with product development, and business teams. The successful candidate will have passion for data and analytics, be a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Develop business metrics and analysis to inform product strategy and influence key strategic initiatives.  
Develop clear communications for recommended actions.  
Establish self-service automated reporting processes for tracking and diving deep into the data.  
Partner with data engineers to establish new data pipelines and document logic for business metrics.  
Use machine learning and statistical techniques to infer impact of product and policy decisions on business outcomes.  
  
A day in the life  
As a Business Analyst, you will help develop an analytic solution to drive deep dives, provide insights into the health and state of the Operations and measure business impact. You will transform data into actionable business information, and will make it readily accessible to stakeholders worldwide. You will own the design, creation, and management of extremely large datasets. You will interact with internal program and product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements, structure scalable and perform data solutions, and gain a deep understanding of key datasets. You will design, implement and drive adoption of new analytic technologies and solutions and promote industry standard best practices. jobs.description:
**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports & Cine Optics.

ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales & Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.

Further information at ZEISS India .

As a Technical Product Owner (TPO), you will be the key bridge between business owners and data engineering teams translating business needs into technical requirements guiding the data engineering team from requirements to release. You will combine business domain knowledge with modern data stack technical expertise to deliver high quality data solutions to our Supply Chain data products. You will work closely with data engineers, global analytics teams and business stakeholders, to plan and drive the end-to-end data data solution delivery from ingestion to analytics-ready datasets.

  

You will collaborate with the stakeholders to define and maintain a healthy product backlog with well-scoped epics, user stories with clear technical requirements and acceptance criteria for streamlined releases. You will develop a working understanding of the data platform, architecture, ingestion patterns, governance frameworks, QC and security to ask the right questions during requirements and planning stages to scope work accurately and present a realistic plan for delivery.

As a TPO you are expected to know and understand current architecture patterns and industry trends in the Data & AI landscape to evaluate trade offs, assess risks and plan effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  

* Responsible for the design, development, and governance of data pipelines and data platforms (ETL/ELT, ELT, streaming) supporting supply chain use-cases (procurement, inventory, logistics, demand planning, supplier management).
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions; present progress, trade-offs, updates, pre-empt delays and ROI.
* Deliver scalable data products owning the data modeling for domain-specific needs.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, data security, compliance, and audit readiness for domain data assets.
* Optimize data platform for performance and cost; evaluate with technical architect via POC’s and implement emerging data technologies as needed.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives (ERP, WMS/TMS, external data feeds) and oversee data integration projects.

Required Qualifications

* 7-8 years of experience in data engineering or related field; 2-3 years in a product owner / SBA role.
* Strong expertise in data modeling, ETL/ELT design, data warehousing, and modern data platforms (data lake, data lakehouse, warehouse), SQL.
* Proficiency with distributed data processing frameworks (Databricks, Spark) and batch/streaming data pipelines.
* 3+ years experience with Azure cloud data platform (Fabric/ADF), data catalogs, metadata and governance.
* Domain knowledge in supply chain: procurement, inventory management, order fulfillment, logistics, transportation, supplier performance.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions, document and present them stakeholders and teams.
* Experience implementing data governance, data quality frameworks, and data security controls.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with supply chain analytics or operations research use cases (demand forecasting, network optimization, inventory optimization).
* Knowledge of ERP/WMS/TMS integrations and data exchange formats (API, JSON, CSV files).
* Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
* Experience with data mesh concepts, data contracts, and domain-driven design in data platforms.
* Certifications in cloud data platforms or data engineering (e.g., Azure/Databricks certifications) is a plus.

Key Skills

* Data lifecycle, data modeling, data governance, data quality
* ETL/ELT design, streaming pipelines, batch processing
* Cloud data platforms and data warehousing
* Supply chain domain knowledge; stakeholder management
* Leadership, mentoring, project management, and cross-functional collaboration

Communication, influence, and ability to present complex concepts clearly.

jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Amazon Business, Private Brand, Recommerce
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is reinventing how organizations of every size buy, sell, and recover value — and Amazon India is on a fast-growing trajectory across three businesses: Amazon Business, Private Brands, and ReCommerce. That growth depends on one thing: India rapidly adopting the tools, platforms, and AI capabilities being built across the company, rather than rebuilding them. We are hiring a Seattle-based Senior Technical Program Manager to own that mission end to end.  
  
In this high-visibility role, you will be the single owner of capability alignment between India and the global teams that build Amazon's products, spanning Amazon Business, Private Brands, and ReCommerce. Sitting at the interface between India's businesses and the teams that build the roadmaps, you will ensure India is represented when new capabilities are designed, maintain a single view of capability adoption across all three lines of business, sequence the cross-organizational dependencies , and advocate for India's priorities in global planning.  
  
This is a rare front-row seat; You will work hand-in-hand with the teams building Amazon's newest business models and agentic AI products — from enterprise procurement and conversational commerce to intelligent, automated operations — gaining exposure to latest technology and go-to-market approaches before they scale, and shaping how they reach one of Amazon's most important growth markets.  
  
If you excel at influence without authority, thrive across organizational and geographic boundaries, and want a strategic mandate with executive visibility at the leading edge of Amazon's fastest-growing businesses, this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the capability-inclusion mechanism: Represent India in global product planning, requirements, and design reviews from the outset — converting today's informal, ad-hoc process into a governed, repeatable intake across all three businesses.  
  
Run a single view of capability adoption: Maintain source of truth for the full portfolio of tracked capabilities across the three businesses, with dependency maps and effort sizing, and represent it in global planning and review forums.  
  
Sequence cross-team dependencies: Untangle the multi-team dependency chains that cause launches to slip, coordinating across engineering, product, finance/compliance, and operations teams.  
  
Negotiate funding and execution ownership for India-specific customization work, including the last-mile localization required to bring global capabilities to market in India.  
  
Advocate for India's priorities in global planning, escalating structural blockers to the right leaders with clear, data-backed cases — particularly where India is deprioritized despite its strategic value.  
  
Establish the baseline and reporting that measure adoption progress and inform how the function scales over time.  
  
Partner deeply with the teams building Amazon's newest products and business models, ensuring India's needs are reflected early and that new capabilities reach the market efficiently.  
  
A day in the life  
You start your morning with AI as your co-pilot — using Amazon's internal generative-AI tools to scan overnight changes across the global product roadmaps for all three businesses, summarize what moved, and surface the handful of new capabilities where India isn't yet in the design conversation. What used to take an analyst days, you triage before your first meeting.  
  
Mid-morning, you join a working session with a product team building one of Amazon's newest AI-powered capabilities, aligning India into their next release so the market isn't left to catch up later. You then prepare for the executive review you own — a recurring leadership forum where you present the single view of capability adoption across the three businesses, call out risks and dependencies, and drive decisions with senior leaders on what India needs and when.  
  
In the afternoon, you unblock a stalled dependency: a global capability that needs a market-specific compliance change before India can adopt it. You get the owning teams and India's tech lead aligned on sequencing and funding, turning a multi-quarter stall into a committed plan. Alongside the day-to-day, you're steering the India launch of a multi-million-dollar product — coordinating engineering, finance, and operations across two continents to bring a capability to one of Amazon's most important growth markets.  
  
You close the day the way you opened it — with AI doing the heavy lifting: drafting an escalation, modeling a dependency sequence, and building the data-backed case for why a high-value capability should reach India sooner. You are not just adopting Amazon's AI tools; you are living at the frontier of how they change the way work gets done.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**# About the team and the role**

  
  

**\*\*The Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) team\*\*** focuses on making selling on eBay simple, fast, and rewarding for everyday sellers, from listing and shipping to getting paid and selling again. C2C is a key growth engine for eBay: it brings unique inventory to the marketplace, and sellers who also buy drive significantly more demand across the platform. The team works to grow and retain the C2C seller base, improve selling velocity, and strengthen this buyer–seller flywheel.

  
  

**\*\*In this role\*\*** in the Indian Analytics Centre, you will be a hands-on analytics partner for C2C product initiatives. You will take well-scoped and moderately ambiguous product questions, break them down into clear analyses, and turn your findings into crisp insights and recommendations. Working closely with senior analysts and the analytics manager, you will build strong product and data depth in C2C and grow towards independently owning larger problem spaces. The role suits someone who is curious, self-driven, and eager to take ownership of their work.

  
  

**# What you will accomplish**

  
  

* Own analytics for defined C2C workstreams

  
  

* Measure how C2C product changes move core outcomes such as seller growth, listings, sold items, and incremental GMV, and help identify the levers that make C2C sellers more successful.

  
  

* Break down product and business questions into structured analyses with clear hypotheses and success metrics, with guidance on scoping for broader or more ambiguous problems.

  
  

* Use strong SQL and analytical rigour to analyse customer behaviour, product performance, feature adoption, funnels, and cohorts across large datasets.

  
  

* Turn analysis into clear, well-structured insights and recommendations for product managers and working teams, and contribute to narratives shared with senior stakeholders.

  
  

* Partner with product, engineering, design, and peer analytics teams on day-to-day questions, and keep stakeholders informed on progress, findings, and risks.

  
  

* Support measurement for product tests and launches, including defining metrics, building dashboards, monitoring performance, and diagnosing changes.

  
  

* Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting that enable consistent performance tracking and self-service.

  
  

* Look beyond the immediate ask, flag anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities in the data, and bring them to the team with a point of view.

  
  

* Maintain high analytical quality by following clear metric definitions, validating data, documenting assumptions, and having work reviewed before it is shared.

  
  

**# What you will bring**

  
  

**## Required qualifications**

  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent practical experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative field.

  
  

* 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related role, ideally in a product or consumer technology setting.

  
  

* Strong hands-on SQL skills and experience analysing large, imperfect datasets with accuracy and attention to detail.

  
  

* Experience in product or business analytics, such as funnel analysis, customer journey analysis, feature adoption, segmentation, or performance measurement.

  
  

* Ability to build clear, user-friendly dashboards and data visualisations using BI or analytics tools.

  
  

* Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals and experiment measurement.

  
  

* Good critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to question assumptions and understand the real question behind an ask.

  
  

* Ability to communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, and to present analysis confidently to product and cross-functional partners.

  
  

* Self-driven and proactive working style, with a strong sense of ownership and the willingness to ask questions, raise issues, and move work forward.

  
  

* Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high standards for data quality and timely delivery.

  
  

* An AI-first mindset and interest in using AI-enabled tools to improve analytical productivity and synthesis.

  
  

**## Good to have**

  
  

* Working knowledge of Python for exploratory analysis, automation, or prototyping.

  
  

* Exposure to causal inference or quasi-experimental methods.

  
  

* Experience with product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar tools.

  
  

* Experience in e-commerce, online marketplaces, seller or creator platforms, or consumer technology.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. jobs.title: Finance Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Finance Innovation & Transformation (FIT) organization partners closely with FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and Technology teams to modernize financial planning, improve data transparency, and enable faster, more confident decision making across the enterprise.
  
  
FIT focuses on aligning planning processes, systems, and data to support scalable forecasting, accurate reporting, and operational excellence across Finance.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are seeking a Business Analyst – Finance Systems with a strong FP&A orientation to support the accuracy, reliability, and usability of eBay’s financial planning and reporting ecosystem. This role works across Anaplan, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and automation tools to ensure that Finance stakeholders have trusted data for planning, forecasting, and performance analysis.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of FP&A processes and financial systems, with demonstrated strength in auditing data, reconciling variances, and resolving reporting issues across integrated platforms.
  
  
What You Will Accomplish
  
  

* Support day‑to‑day operations of FP&A‑critical systems including Anaplan, SAP S/4HANA, and SAC, ensuring stable planning and reporting cycles
* Partner closely with FP&A teams during budgeting, forecasting, and outlook cycles, supporting data readiness, validation, and issue resolution
* Assist in the design, requirements and testing of Anaplan planning models, S4 implementations, & SAC reports, documenting requirements and test scripts, and testing to ensure implementation accuracy & success
* Perform end‑to‑end audits and reconciliations between planning, ERP, and reporting systems to ensure forecast and actuals alignment
* Investigate and explain plan vs. actual, forecast vs. forecast, and reporting variances, identifying root causes related to data, mappings, or system behavior
* Validate planning master data, hierarchies, drivers, and assumptions to ensure consistency across models and reports
* Support management and executive reporting by ensuring data accuracy, timing, and transparency
* Leverage automation, AI and analytics tools to streamline reconciliations, variance analysis, and validation checks, reducing manual effort
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT) for planning model changes, system upgrades, and new integrations impacting FP&A processes
* Maintain validation reports, reconciliation frameworks, and documentation to support auditability and repeatable planning cycles
* Collaborate with Accounting, IT, and data teams to resolve integration, timing, and data quality issues affecting forecasts and reports
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on forecast accuracy, planning efficiency, and data trust

What You Will Bring
  
  

* 5+ years of experience supporting FP&A, finance systems, or financial planning and reporting processes
* Hands‑on experience with planning and reporting platforms such as Anaplan, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, or similar tools
* Solid experience in auditing, reconciling, and validating planning and actuals data across multiple systems
* Ability to analyze and resolve forecasting and reporting discrepancies with clear, finance‑based explanations
* Demonstrated expertise in FP&A processes, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting
* Experience supporting planning-to-ERP integrations and understanding how upstream data impacts forecasts
* Proficiency with automation or data preparation tools (e.g., Alteryx, advanced Excel) to support FP&A analysis and controls
* Ability to handle competing priorities during critical planning and close timelines
* Good communication skills, with the ability to translate system behavior into FP&A‑relevant insights
* Exposure to global FP&A operations or COE models preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
